Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Offer packet: Senior PM (Band 5) — clarity on RSU & bonus

Hi Marcus / Karthik —

Putting the proposed pay mix for Eleanor Park (internal candidate ID REQ-1984) on your radar. Hiring manager confirmed they want to move quickly; recruiting has candidate ready to sign pending comp confirmation. Summary below and a draft offer attached.

Proposed package (standard band 5 template):
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 15% of base (uncapped, discretionary)
- Equity: 18,000 RSUs (grant value at offer) with 4-year vesting
- Sign-on: $10,000 one-time (requested by manager to offset relocation)
- Start date target: 2028-09-04

Questions for comp approval:
1) RSU vesting cadence — should we use the standard 12mo cliff then monthly thereafter, or sign off on manager's request for a quarterly post-cliff schedule?
2) Is the $10k sign-on within delegated approval? If not, need exec sign-off and a budget charge code.
3) Any guidance on bonus pro-ration if start < full quarter?

Attachments: E_Park_offer_summary.pdf (draft), comp_approval_sheet.xlsx (fill for approvals).

Can you confirm whether we can proceed with the numbers as-is or need to adjust RSU or sign-on before sending? Hiring manager would like offer out by Friday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Date: 2028-07-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer packet: Senior PM (Band 5) — clarity on RSU & bonus

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Two quick asks before I sign off:
- Please include the OTE math (base + target bonus) and a simple $/year estimate at current grant price for the RSU so I can see comp positioning vs. other PM hires.
- Prefer standard vesting cadence for consistency (12-month cliff then monthly). Manager's quarterly request is fine only if we document why (retain/relocation risk).

If sign-on is <= $12k and the hiring budget is PRE-APP-84, I'm comfortable approving. If the team needs $15k+, escalate to Laura for approval.

Send me the updated comp_approval_sheet and I'll sign.

Marcus
Dir, Product Management
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-31T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer packet: Senior PM (Band 5) — clarity on RSU & bonus

Marissa / Marcus —

Confirming compensation guardrails for Band 5 (standard practice):
- Base salary band: $150,000 — $180,000. $165k is squarely in-range.
- Target bonus: 12% — 16%. 15% is fine. For offers >15% please annotate rationale.
- RSU philosophy: typical grant sizes are 16k—22k for Band 5. Standard vesting is 4 years with a 12-month cliff, then monthly thereafter. Quarterly vesting post-cliff is allowed only in documented retention cases; not default.
- Sign-on approvals: Comp team can approve up to $12k for lateral PM hires; anything above needs VP/People sign-off (Laura).
- Pro-ration: first-year bonus and equity pro-rate from start date per policy; include explicit pro-ration language in offer.

I reviewed the attached comp_approval_sheet.xlsx and added the approver line and budget code PROJ-PRE-84. I approved the package contingent on:
1) Marissa updating the RSU vesting language to standard cadence (12mo cliff + monthly)
2) Sign-on reduced to $12k or obtain Laura's ok for $10k (which is within our delegated range)

Attachment: comp_approval_sheet.xlsx (signed: karthik_iyer).

If you want, Marcus, you can sign the final and Marissa can send to candidate.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Director, Total Rewards
